definition: Two or more devices connected to share data
example: Laptop and printer on home Wi-Fi
examTip: Includes wired and wireless; doesn't require the internet

definition: Very short-range network around one person
analogy: Whispering to the person next to you
example: Smartwatch paired to a phone over Bluetooth

definition: Network covering one location, like a home or office
example: Office Wi-Fi and Ethernet connecting every desk
examTip: Size order: PAN, LAN, CAN, MAN, WAN

definition: Connects devices within the same network
analogy: Hallways connecting rooms in a building
example: The box under a desk with many Ethernet cables

definition: Connects different networks and directs traffic between them
analogy: The mailroom deciding where outgoing letters go
example: Home router sending LAN traffic to the internet
examTip: Routers connect networks; switches connect devices

definition: Converts the ISP's signal into data your network can use (modulator-demodulator)
analogy: Loading dock where the building meets the public road
example: The cable or fiber box from your ISP
examTip: Faces the ISP side; not the same as a router

definition: Lets wireless devices join a wired network
example: Wi-Fi unit mounted on an office ceiling

definition: One network carrying voice, data and video as IP packets
analogy: One delivery truck carrying letters, packages and newspapers
example: Zoom calls and file downloads on the same office connection
examTip: Voice and video need QoS on converged networks

definition: Percentage of time a network or service is working
analogy: Percentage of hours a store is actually open
example: Status page showing 99.98% uptime this month
examTip: 100% isn't realistic; high availability is the goal

analogy: A store closed only 5 minutes all year
example: Carrier-grade phone systems, critical data centers
examTip: About 5 minutes downtime per year. Four nines is about 53 minutes.

definition: Formal agreement defining expected service levels, like uptime
example: Cloud provider promising 99.99% uptime or service credits
examTip: The SLA is where the uptime target is officially stated
